scientific_integrity: The mathematical claim is analytically proved, with an exact-arithmetic finite checker as supplementary evidence; public sources establish context, not independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to period-three sequences of single length-two base-k cylinder holes under Lebesgue initial measure; earlier equivalent forms may exist. No statement about general moving intervals, simultaneous forbidden words or arbitrary initial measures.
title: Four overlap classes and a minimal temporal-order escape transition for three-stage Markov holes
